title: Per-project owner overrides for deny-by-default tools (.harness/project/tool-overrides.json)
description: The project owner's decision to turn a registry tool marked default_action=deny into ASK -- the person approves every call. Never allow: ASK is the only action. Project-owned: bundle installs never ship or overwrite .harness/project/. Written by the owner (AI writes are blocked by self-protect-paths.json). harnessd ignores an incomplete or expired entry and keeps the deny.

action.description: The only relaxation allowed: ask the person every time

expires_on.description: Optional; after this date the deny is back
